name: Port-de-Paix

queries.query: Haiti official cadastre parcel map Port-de-Paix parcelles cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official CIAT land/cadastre institutional page, the official IHSI geographic-data page, the official DGI site map, the official SIA Haiti map, and the official Port-de-Paix municipal site. No public parcel viewer or open parcel geometry service was identified.

queries.query: Haïti cadastre officiel parcelles Port-de-Paix / Ayiti kadas peyi Pòdepè kat tè
queries.result: French and Haitian-Creole discovery reached the same official CIAT, IHSI, DGI, SIA Haiti, and municipal sources. The SIA viewer's exposed layers are administrative and environmental (department, commune, section, watersheds, rivers, cities), not cadastral parcels; no safe parcel ID or polygon endpoint was found.

officialViewer.operator: Ministère de l'Agriculture, des Ressources Naturelles et du Développement Rural with CNIGS/CNSA branding
officialViewer.inspection: Browser-like TLS-verified GET returned HTTP 200. Inline JavaScript loads /geo/geojson/departement, /geo/geojson/commune, /geo/geojson/section and static watershed/river/city GeoJSON. No parcel layer, parcel service, native parcel ID field, or parcel schema was exposed.
officialViewer.crs: Leaflet map configured EPSG:3857; no cadastral service CRS exists to record.

registryBasis: No Port-de-Paix local registry/cadastre map, procedure, or public parcel service was directly evidenced. National institutional references are not enough to assert a local registry source.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative/environmental map layers only; no parcel geometry or parcel schema verified.

technicalBlocker: No public cadastral viewer, anonymous parcel endpoint, or open parcel vector service was exposed by the inspected first-party sources. The CIAT request was 503; the SIA viewer has no parcel layer; DGI and the municipal site expose no safe parcel route.
remainingUncertainty: The WUP point was preserved and never used to force a parcel query. Public availability, current update currency, legal boundary status, municipal coverage, parcel identifiers, geometry access, and any local cadastral custodian remain unresolved. A zero exact-point hit, unavailable page, timeout, login wall, or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
